system_diagnosis: The evaluation and contract infrastructure is stronger than demonstrated open-world interpretation coverage.
Lexical coverage is a major bottleneck but does not explain all syntax, semantic composition, operator, and discourse failures.
No naturalistic evaluation population currently supports a claim about real-world request distribution.
The JavaScript Workbench target is not executed by the current open-world browser campaign.
Phase 6 semantic construction expansion remains blocked by independent bilingual gold-data and rights requirements.

assessment_limitations: This assessment synthesizes existing repository evidence; it is not a fresh run of every benchmark.

Structural/operation tests do not establish general semantic correctness.
